items.q: How fast can you dispatch an auction pickup?
items.a: Inside business hours, a Copart or IAAI pickup is posted to Central Dispatch within 30 minutes. Manheim adds a gate-pass step (usually 4-24 hours). Carriers typically accept within 2-6 hours on common lanes; a first-available pickup usually happens inside 48-72 hours.

items.q: Do you handle Copart + IAAI + Manheim from one account?
items.a: Yes. One dealer account works for every major platform. Share the lot number and buyer ID; we handle the gate pass, payment-status check with the auction, and carrier dispatch under a single workflow.

items.q: How does weekly consolidated invoicing work?
items.a: Every Friday at 9 AM ET we close the week's loads, calculate consolidated totals, and email a single PDF invoice with each load itemized. Due net-15 via ACH or Zelle. Net-30 available on approved accounts after 90 days of clean payment history.

items.q: What happens when a carrier damages a vehicle?
items.a: You file a claim with the carrier's insurance (cargo coverage is typically $100,000-$250,000 for open trailers, $250,000-$500,000 for enclosed). We pull the carrier's COI and connect you with their adjuster. Y7 does not take direct liability for cargo — we're a licensed broker, not a motor carrier — but we absolutely stay in the loop and advocate for fast resolution.

items.q: Can I track loads in real time?
items.a: Yes — dedicated dealer portal with pickup/in-transit/delivered status, plus a Telegram bot that pushes notifications to your dispatcher's phone. BOL photos at pickup and delivery are attached automatically.

items.q: Do you ship dealer trades between lots?
items.a: Regularly. Dealer trade moves are our second-largest dealer use case after auction pickup. Single-vehicle or multi-vehicle swaps between rooftops, coordinated timing, and a dedicated dispatcher to sync pickup and drop-off windows.

Free cancellation any time before the carrier accepts the load. Once accepted, the carrier's rules apply (typically $100-$200 dry-run fee if the driver has already dispatched to the pickup location). We flag this in the Telegram feed the moment acceptance happens so you can cancel cleanly.

items.q: Can you handle non-running auction vehicles?
items.a: Yes. Plan on a $100-$300 inoperable surcharge above the base rate — actual amount depends on whether a standard winch works (cheaper) or the vehicle needs forklift loading (more). Disclose this honestly at quote time so the right carrier is dispatched; mis-disclosed inop at pickup is the #1 cause of surprise fees.

items.q: What about port delivery for your export flips?
items.a: We coordinate auction-to-port for dealers selling into the export channel. Gate pass, warehouse drop, and BOL handoff to the freight forwarder — we do the domestic leg; your forwarder handles customs and ocean booking.

items.q: How do I get a rate card?
items.a: Email us your dealer license + the lanes and monthly volume you're planning. We build a personalized rate card within 24 hours. Pricing reflects your actual volume and lane mix, not a published retail rate.
